Turan Automotive Unveils New Electric SUV in Istanbul Launch

Turan Automotive, one of Turkey’s leading automotive manufacturers, unveiled its latest electric vehicle, the EfeX SUV, at a product launch in Istanbul on Thursday. The new model marks the company’s entry into the increasingly competitive electric vehicle (EV) segment, reflecting growing consumer demand for sustainable mobility solutions in Turkey and across the region.

The EfeX SUV, which will be assembled at Turan’s Bursa plant, is expected to hit Turkish showrooms in early September. Company officials stated that the vehicle boasts a range of up to 420 kilometers on a single charge and features a locally-developed battery system. Pricing will begin at 1.2 million Turkish lira, positioning the model in the mid-to-upper segment of the domestic EV market.

"Our vision is to drive Turkey’s transition to electric mobility," said Turan Automotive CEO Selim Korkmaz during the launch event. "With EfeX, we are delivering a vehicle that combines Turkish engineering with the latest EV technology, tailored to the needs of our customers."

Industry observers note that the launch comes as Turkey’s EV market shows signs of rapid expansion. According to the Turkish Automotive Manufacturers Association, domestic EV sales more than doubled year-on-year in the first quarter of 2024, with over 28,000 units sold. The government has also introduced incentives for electric vehicle purchases and continues to invest in nationwide charging infrastructure.

"The EfeX is well-timed," said Melis Yıldırım, an analyst at Istanbul-based consultancy MotorTrend Insights. "With consumer interest on the rise and more charging stations being deployed, Turan is positioning itself to capture a significant share of the new energy vehicle market."

The launch event was attended by government officials, industry executives, and representatives of the Turkish Motor Vehicle Union. Union president Ahmet Şahin praised the investment, noting, "This product supports local employment and showcases the growing capabilities of Turkey’s automotive sector."

Turan Automotive has indicated plans to begin exports of the EfeX to selected European markets in 2025, after establishing a strong domestic base. The company will begin accepting orders from Turkish customers next week.
